Root cause narrowed to **`@docusaurus/babel/lib/preset.js`** running `@babel/preset-env` with implicit `modules: 'auto'` on the server target (vs `modules: false` for client) — this transforms `() => import(spec)` into `() => Promise.resolve().then(() => _interopRequireWildcard(require(spec)))` BEFORE webpack sees the code, and the resulting nested CJS `require(spec)` in an arrow-function expression is not rewritten by webpack's static analyzer (the helper import on the same line IS rewritten to `__webpack_require__(807)`, proving webpack processed the module — it just doesn't deep-walk arrow-nested CJS requires). Path (B) framing from wave-22 also invalidated: `@site/docs/*.mdx` has **no on-disk compiled output** under `.docusaurus/` — only metadata JSON; the compiled React components live exclusively in `build/assets/js/<chunkId>.<hash>.js` in client-format `webpackChunk_*.push(...)` payload, which is not directly Node-loadable without sandbox-eval. **Narrowed fix paths (in order of preference): (1) patch `@docusaurus/babel/lib/preset.js` to use `modules: false` for the server preset-env config (matching client) — 1-2 h; (2) custom babel plugin in `apps/docs/babel.config.js` that rewrites nested `require("@site/X")` back to top-level import — 2-3 h; (3) `ssgRequire` patch that sandbox-evals `build/assets/js/<chunkId>.<hash>.js` client chunks (workaround, not root-cause fix) — 3-5 h. Wave-22's path-B framing supersededby path (3) above; path (1) recommended primary.** No changes to source files this wave (configureWebpack plugin removed before commit because it shifted no symptoms — keeping the dead-end code would mis-document the diagnosis).
